notes: LFM3-Omni-2B_int8.litertlm of litert-community/LFM3-Omni-2B-LiteRT: the LiteRT-LM bundle of LiquidAI/LFM3-Omni-2B at revision ce2458cb (LFM Open License v1.0) - text, pictures and audio in; the photo voice chat sample runs its sections in its own loop, with the repo's speech graphs for speech out. Published as litert-community/LFM3-Omni-2B-LiteRT (upload commit 6450f061, main 7e4f3d23 at the anonymous Hub read 2026-11-01T04:39:11+09:00, each LFS oid and size = artifact_sha256 and the hold's model list). App rows: the photo voice chat sample (a litert-samples app; the builds of its tree, the APK in each signature) opens the bundle's sections and the speech graphs with LiteRT 2.3.0's Kotlin CompiledModel, not through LiteRT-LM; its engine also held the hold's other depth graphs open, and only the graphs named in a signature ran in those answers or readings; airplane mode, a heat gate before each answer or reading (the gate lines in the score files and run.log); the holds' logcat and delegate files hold the delegation lines, which these records do not parse; os_build = the Android version in the app's report (no build id).
quantization: fp32-equivalent per-channel rewrite (alpha 0.65 on w2, out_proj and both norms; scales from 16 held-out calibration sequences) then dynamic-range int8 weights (dynamic_wi8_afp32) in the decoder and the embedder; vision encoder fp32 + adapter fp16, audio encoder fp32; generic_model, pictures 512 x 512 (256 rows), KV cache 4096, no activation type declared (the GPU runs float16 activations by default)

speech_out_1s_ms = the generation loop's ms per second of speech (the app's report); the per-part figures are means over the answers' steps / frames / calls, so latency_p50_ms stays null; the other forms of the order ran depth graphs that are not published and have no record
